text: Pilot hypothesis: post-festival closeout and institutional-memory graph
description: After the festival, ingest permissioned task lists, meeting notes, contracts/invoice trackers, and short operator interviews into an inspectable graph of outstanding obligations, decisions, dependencies, owners, and reusable lessons. The agent proposes follow-ups and detects missing closeout items; humans approve messages, payments, contractual decisions, and status changes. Measure unresolved items after 7/14/30 days, invoice/contract turnaround, manager hours, and time needed to retrieve why a decision was made. Best first wedge for Wilde Möhre because it creates value after the event without destabilizing live production.

status.comment: Workflow hypothesis awaiting operator evidence; do not build before validating real pain, ownership, artifacts, baseline, and willingness to pay.
